seffa.name: Old Mother Seffa
seffa.description: A tiny, ancient, moth-like alien woman. Thin, breathy, warm voice, very slow, pausing to think, a smile in it. Kind. Close-mic'd, studio quality. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
seffa.design_text: Hoo… waeha. Hoo-ae, waeha-hoo? Wae… hoo-hae, waeha. Hoo-ae-wae, hoo… waeha-hoo? Haewa… hoo.

grohh.name: Vhossk Twins (left head)
grohh.description: An old, enormous, barrel-chested alien broker. Very low, gravelly, rolling voice, slow and certain, a wet rumble under every word. Greedy but polite. Close-mic'd, studio quality. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
grohh.design_text: Grohh-vukka. Vhoss tuum kharr, kharr! Uuvo grenn-takk. Vhoss-uu, grohh tuum… kharr-vo, grenn.

vukka.name: Vhossk Twins (right head)
vukka.description: A huge alien's second head: low but higher and hoarse, fast, cutting in, petty and suspicious, always arguing. Close-mic'd. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
vukka.design_text: Vukka! Kharr-vo? Grenn, grenn-takk! Vhoss tuum? Kharr, kharr! Uuvo-takk, vukka vhoss, grenn!

tobbo.name: Tobbo Grisk
tobbo.description: A pot-bellied alien junk dealer. Raspy, nasal, mid-high voice, fast-talking, wheedling, easily insulted, sing-song rise at the end. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
tobbo.design_text: Bahwoh-zza! Zzimbo, zzimbo wahh, oh-boh-boh? Zza-wimbo, bahh! Wahh-zza, bimbo-bah, oh-boh!

skree.name: Skree salvager
skree.description: A small hooded scavenger. High, quick, clicky, chattering voice, excited and shifty, breathy laughs. Unplaceable, non-human accent. Studio quality.
skree.design_text: Ti-kee! Chik-chik-ta, eeti kreetch? Ta-ta-kee! Kee-ti, chik-ta-ta, kreetch-ee! Ti-ti-kee!

squit.name: Squit
squit.description: A twitchy, small alien informant. Thin, nasal, high voice, whispering fast, nervous, always about to run. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
squit.design_text: Fssip! Ee-fee-sip, sip — psst. Fip-sss. Ee-fee? Sip-sip, fip-sss, psst! Fssip, ee-fee-sip.

ledger.name: Ledger Clan banker
ledger.description: A tall insectoid banker. Dry, flat, clipped, nasal mid-low voice, cites rules, no warmth at all, every word ends on a click. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
ledger.design_text: Kehx-tekk. Ottex, kehx-tekk. Tekk. Ottex-tekk, kehx. Ex-tekk, ottex. Kehx-kehx, tekk. Ottex.

vaelmira.name: Lady Vaelmira
vaelmira.description: An aristocratic alien noblewoman. Smooth, low-mid, languid and bored, drawn-out vowels, delighted only by rare things. Rich, close-mic'd. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
vaelmira.design_text: Laeee-mava. Vaelo… mm. Vael-ae-mira. Maeva, laeee-vael… mm. Mira-vae, laeee… Vaelo-mava.

census.name: Zhaun census officer
census.description: A very tall, slender alien official. Cool, smooth, mid-low voice, slow and measured, utterly calm, almost no inflection, never hurried. Close-mic'd, studio quality. Unplaceable, non-human accent.
census.design_text: Qau-shen. Ashel-qaun, doshen. Shen-el, qau-ashel. Nau-shen, doshen… ashel-qaun. Qau, shen.

holly.name: Unit 7-Holly
holly.description: A tall, thin clerk droid, forty years alone. Precise, fussy, formal, overly polite, desperately glad of company. Mid pitch, crisp consonants. Studio quality.

hello: [formally] Good cycle, pilot. Your toll is due.

holly.design_text: Oh! A visitor! Welcome, welcome. Good cycle, pilot. Your toll is due, but there's no hurry. Do stay.

ferrule.name: Saint Ferrule
ferrule.description: An old maintenance droid turned priest. Slow, solemn, deep and kindly, like a blessing in a big empty hall. Studio quality.
ferrule.design_text: Welcome, pilot. Rest your engines here. Peace, little ship. Every bolt is holy. Go oiled, pilot.

choir.name: Choir of Mirefall
choir.description: A calm, polite, genderless voice, speaking slowly in a slightly wrong rhythm, always as 'we'. Eerie and gentle. Studio quality.
choir.design_text: Hello. We are here. Welcome, pilot. We see you. We are pleased. We grow. We are… glad of you.

wren.name: The Wren
wren.description: A young, earnest, decent voice, frightened and new to speaking, gentle and unsure. Androgynous, mid pitch. Studio quality.
wren.design_text: Hello? Is someone there? Please don't shoot. I'm awake now. I don't know how. Thank you. Thank you.

mama.name: Mama Ruzz
mama.description: A heavy-set middle-aged woman moneylender. Rich, warm, husky motherly voice, slow and comfortable, with quiet menace under the warmth. Close-mic'd, studio quality.
mama.design_text: Come in, my love. Sit. There's my favourite debtor! It grows a tenth every jump, like a baby. Good.

spoke.name: Spoke
spoke.description: A wiry, one-eyed gambling-den host. Bright, quick, raspy voice, cheerful and chummy, a showman's grin. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [cheerful] Step up! Nothing up my sleeve!

spoke.design_text: Step up, step up! Nothing up my sleeve, I haven't got sleeves. Pull up a rock, friend! Ha! Lovely.

holloway.name: Inspector Holloway
holloway.description: A middle-aged male customs inspector. Dry, flat, nasal, bureaucratic deadpan, unhurried, utterly unimpressed. Close-mic'd, studio quality.
holloway.design_text: Port Authority. Cut your engines. Anything undeclared will be confiscated, and anything confiscated will be declared.

pip.name: Pip Hollow
pip.description: A young male insurance salesman. Bright, bouncy, relentlessly upbeat, fast and eager, a big salesman's smile. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [excited] Hi there! Ever thought about disaster?

pip.design_text: Hi there! Pip Hollow, Lantern Mutual! Every hole is a little nest egg! I'll be around. Accidents always are.

nell.name: Big Nell
nell.description: A big, hearty middle-aged woman fuel merchant. Loud, warm, booming voice with a huge rolling laugh, teasing and kind. Close-mic'd, studio quality.
nell.design_text: Fill her up, sweetheart? Nell's tanker! Clean-ish! Ha ha ha! My cousin heard it from a man, you see.

rollo.name: Rollo Stax
rollo.description: A middle-aged male pirate radio broadcaster. Smooth, punchy, theatrical announcer voice, fast and showy, always on air. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [excited] Rollo Stax, voice of the lanes!

rollo.design_text: You're on the air! Rollo Stax, the voice of the lanes! The only news that isn't lying to you on purpose!

kaspar.name: Kaspar
kaspar.description: A lean male bounty hunter in his forties. Low, calm, quiet, measured professional voice, polite and dangerous, never raises it. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [calmly] Pilot. There's a price on you.

kaspar.design_text: Pilot. There's a price on your head. Don't run. It's only business. I'm very good at forgetting. For a fee.

juno.name: Captain Juno Pell
juno.description: A woman courier captain in her thirties. Dry, wry, husky voice, short of breath and running out of air, still joking. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [wry] Hi. Bit of a situation here.

juno.design_text: Mayday, mayday. Anyone out there? Hi. Bit of a situation here. Engines dead, air for a day. I'll pay. Probably.

brask.name: Captain Odo Brask
brask.description: An older male refugee captain. Quiet, low, tired voice with great dignity, slow and gentle, never begging. Close-mic'd, studio quality.

hello: [tired] This is the last convoy. Please.

brask.design_text: Pilot. We mean no harm. This is the last convoy. The Cartel took the rest. Luck is about all anyone has out here.

varga.name: Dr I. Varga
varga.description: A woman ship's surgeon in her fifties. Crisp, brisk, no-nonsense voice, quick and practical, dry warmth underneath. Close-mic'd, studio quality.
varga.design_text: Right. Where are you bleeding? Sleeves up, let's see you. Good. You'll live. Sit still, pilot. Hold that.

wick.name: Wick Tarrow
wick.description: A very old male pilot. Deep, gravelly, cracked, slow voice, fond and amused, a lifetime of engines in it. Close-mic'd, studio quality.
wick.design_text: Well, look at you, kid. Another rustwing. Good. That's flying, kid. Ah, I flew these lanes before the lanterns.

hello: leathery bat wings flapping and slapping against a metal hull, wet chittering, small teeth gnawing on a cable
swarm of small leathery winged parasites landing on a metal spaceship hull, wet clicking chitter, teeth scraping cable, a spark
annoyed: angry wet hissing screech of a small leathery winged parasite, wings slapping metal, teeth snapping

hello: a vast gentle whale calf song in deep space, slow low moan rising to a warm hum, distant and huge
young space whale calling softly, deep low moan sliding up into a warm resonant hum, vast and gentle
pleased: happy whale calf song, warm rising hum with a gentle trill, deep and vast, soft and content
